description: Ask a VibeBooking hotel a question its published facts may answer: parking, wifi, luggage, check-in, children, getting there. outcome answered gives the hotel's own text in answer, to quote as written; unanswered means the hotel has not published one, and the question has been sent to it, so say so and never guess; urgent means a person is needed now. Follow say. To book, give booking_url. hotel is the id from search_hotels or resolve_hotel, or the hotel's domain.

hotel.description: The hotel id from search_hotels or resolve_hotel, or the hotel's website domain.

lang.description: The language to answer in, as a tag such as en, ja, zh or ko; the hotel's own when it has not published that one.

question.description: The traveller's question about the hotel, in their own words and language. Leave out names, emails and phone numbers.

name: ask_hotel
title: Ask the hotel
